HPX_SHORTCUTS.py.summary: Page class for managing HPX Shortcuts screen interactions in Android Smart app. Provides methods for verifying, editing, and managing printer shortcuts including adding, deleting, and navigating shortcut-related screens. The class encapsulates all UI element locators and exposes methods for CRUD operations, modal navigation, and named item selection. It follows Page Object Model, explicit wait, exception handling, fluent interface, and inheritance-based flow patterns. Locators are referenced externally for maintainability, and method signatures are consistent for reliability.
